sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
Proposed change, as said in the meeting: Alluminio B wants to ship the BR-220 billet from its Rovereto plant to catch up. Same alloy 6082-T6. OK for Plant 1?

findings.why: The approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL covers only Alluminio B's Settimo Torinese site, and the record lists that site as the single approved source. Rovereto has no approval for this part, plant and customer.

sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The documents contain no certificate or test result for the Rovereto 6082-T6 billet, including the Rp0.2 value needed for SC-01. The alloy is only stated as the same in the meeting. Someone must supply the certificate or test result.
